claim_text: The September 13, 2022 Farah superseding indictment, No. 0:22-cr-00124 (ECF 57), alleges downstream receipts used to receive and launder Federal Child Nutrition Program funds: Empire Enterprises more than / nearly $7 million (paras 19, 96); Bushra Wholesalers more than $4.5 million (para 26); The Free Minded Institute nearly $2.5 million from Sponsor A, of which over 97 percent was paid to Empire Cuisine and Market (paras 29, 38, 40); MIB Holdings more than $2 million (para 23); and Nur Consulting more than $800,000 (para 25). Face language is received and laundered (amount_paid of overlapping proceeds). These are subsets of the $40 million Empire-group figure and of Empire Cuisine's more-than-$28 million; do not add them to $40 million, Bock $250 million, HSS, or Mohamed $12 million.

supporting_passages.quote: used Empire Enterprises to receive and launder more than $7 million in Federal Child Nutrition Program funds.
Bushra Wholesalers was used to receive and launder more than $4.5 million in Federal Child Nutrition Program funds between approximately February 2021 and January 2022.

The Free Minded Institute received nearly $2.5 million in Federal Child Nutrition Program funds from Sponsor A from October 2021 to January 2022. J.S. paid over 97 percent of these funds to Empire Cuisine and Market.
MAHAD IBRAHIM used MIB Holdings to receive and launder more than $2 million in Federal Child Nutrition Program funds.
ABDIMAJID NUR used Nur Consulting to receive and launder more than $800,000 in Federal Child Nutrition Program funds between approximately April 2021 and January 2022.

amounts.methodology: Para 19 more than $7 million; para 96 nearly $7 million. Same Empire Enterprises figure.
Para 26 Bushra Wholesalers more than $4.5 million received/laundered.
Paras 29/38 FMI nearly $2.5 million; about 97 percent paid onward to Empire.
Para 23 MIB Holdings more than $2 million.

qualifiers: received/laundered proceeds, not independent billed loss
